name: Back Corté
notes: Owner's description: slow, quick, quick, slow, the lead stepping straight back and closing on the last slow, turning a quarter left over the last two steps; from Closed Promenade into closed hold. Standard name; the book starts on the lead's right with a side step on 3, the owner starts on his left (where Closed Promenade leaves him) and every travelling step goes back, the third slightly to the side, curving round outside his standing foot. Her third curves round the front of his right leg and points, like his, the way they face after the close. 2/4. Reviewed by the owner (2026-11-19).

label.lead: back and to the side, turning
